description: Scout (Terry Miller): answers Q1-Q6 then stops

segments.text: Hi, I'm Terry Miller from Canada. The position I'm applying for is Scout for Montreal FC Pro Team.
The current club is Scout for FC Vancouver Pro Academy.
I developed my scouting experience through amateur and youth soccer, initially observing players while supporting coaches.
My responsibility is to identify players who fit the club's needs.
I assess their qualities and limitations, then provide clear recommendations to support the recruitment team's decisions.
I first clarify the club's playing philosophy, recruitment priorities, and budget.
I work with coaches to define the required player profiles and focus my observations on those specific needs.
I observe how players position themselves, scan their surroundings, and anticipate situations.
I pay particular attention to movement without the ball, and their ability to adapt during transitions.
I assess the options available, the timing of the decision, and its suitability for the situation.
A successful action is not always a good decision, so context matters.
I compare the players' habits with the team's playing model.
For example, a possession-based team needs players comfortable receiving under pressure, finding passing options, and maintaining positional discipline.
